title: The signing identity leaks from GitHub

history.what: review: what a leak can and can't do

body: A leaked signing identity can't push an update: Sparkle also needs the update key, which never leaves the Studio. It could sign a look-alike app someone downloads by hand. Response: delete the GitHub secret, make a new identity with make-release-keys.sh, ship the next release with it (each Mac re-grants the permissions once), and say so in SECURITY.md. S-10 refuses any zip not signed with the expected identity.
